subject: Decision Making
title: Psychological Safety
description: A quick, practical guide to Psychological Safety.

hook.text: Google's Project Aristotle studied what makes teams effective. The top factor was not talent.

buildup.text: Psychological safety means team members feel safe to take risks, speak up, and admit mistakes without punishment.

discovery.text: Teams with high safety share more information, catch errors faster, and innovate more.

twist.text: High-performing teams actually report more errors than low-performing teams.

climax.text: Safety does not mean comfort. It means speaking up is safe even when the message is uncomfortable or critical.

punchline.text: Safe to speak up, safe to fail. Psychological safety unlocks honest group.

quiz.question: What is psychological safety in teams?
options: Feeling safe to speak up, take risks, and admit mistakes without fear of punishment
